text:
Njikọ ụwa FIFA nke 2002, nke e mere site na 31 Mee ruo 30 June, bụ mbipụta mbụ e mere na Asia nakwa nke mbụ mba abụọ jikọrọ ọnụ, South Korea na Japan. Ndị otu iri atọ na abụọ ka e kewara n’ime otu asatọ nke anọ ọ bụla, ndị abụọ kacha elu n’ime nke ọ bụla na-aga n’ọkwa knockout nke otu onye na-ewepụ, nke na-aga site na round nke 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals, egwuregwu nke atọ na nke ikpeazụ. Ọ bụ World Cup ikpeazụ iji iwu golden goal, nke metụtara na agba knockout. China, Ecuador, Senegal na Slovenia niile mere mpụta mbụ ha na asọmpi ahụ.

Agba otu mebiri atụmatụ ozugbo: ndị mmeri nchebe France pụọ n’enweghị ihe ọ bụla ha gbara, merie 1–0 site n’aka ndị mbụ Senegal, ha na Uruguay kọrọ 0–0 ma merie Denmark. Akụkọ kacha ogologo oge bụ nke ndị South Korea, ndị Guus Hiddink duziri rute semi-finals—nke kacha mma nke mba Asia na nke mbụ otu si na mpụga UEFA, CONMEBOL na CONCACAF rute ebe ahụ. Ha kwụsịrị na mmeri 1–0 n’aka Germany. N’egwuregwu nke atọ, Turkey meriri South Korea 3–2, egwuregwu nke Hakan Şükür gbara ihe dị ka sekọnd 11 ka egwuregwu malitere, bụ ihe kacha ọsọ na akụkọ World Cup.

Final na International Stadium Yokohama, n’ihu mmadụ 69,029 na 30 June, jikọtara Germany na Brazil. E kpebiri ya n’oge a kara aka, enweghị oge mgbakwunye ma ọ bụ penalty, Brazil meriri 2–0 site na goolu abụọ Ronaldo (67', 79'). Ihe mbụ bịara mgbe onye nche Germany Oliver Kahn tụfuru agba Rivaldo, Ronaldo wee kụọ ya. Mmeri ahụ nyere Brazil aha nke ise; Germany bụ ndị nke abụọ. Ihe abụọ Ronaldo mere bụ mgbapụta onwe ya mgbe mmeri 1998, goolu asatọ ya—nke kacha na asọmpi—bụ nke kacha elu kemgbe Gerd Müller na 1970. N’ụzọ dabara na World Cup a gbanwere, Golden Ball maka onye kacha mma abụghị onye gbara goolu kama ọ bụ Kahn, onye nche mbụ na nke ugbu a naanị ya meriri ihe nrite ahụ, n’agbanyeghị mmejọ ya na final.
